# openmetadata_dashboard_data_model (Resource)

Manages an OpenMetadata dashboard data model: the columns and optional SQL behind a dashboard's charts.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openmetadata_dashboard_service" "warehouse" {
  name         = "warehouse"
  service_type = "CustomDashboard"
}

resource "openmetadata_dashboard_data_model" "sales" {
  name            = "sales_model"
  display_name    = "Sales Model"
  description     = "Model behind the sales dashboard."
  service         = openmetadata_dashboard_service.warehouse.fully_qualified_name
  data_model_type = "PowerBIDataModel"
  sql             = "SELECT region, sum(amount) AS total_sales FROM sales GROUP BY region"

  columns = [
    {
      name         = "region"
      display_name = "Region"
      data_type    = "VARCHAR"
      data_length  = 256
      description  = "Sales region."
    },
    {
      name         = "total_sales"
      display_name = "Total Sales"
      data_type    = "DOUBLE"
      description  = "Sum of all sales in the region."
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `columns` (Attributes List) Columns exposed by the data model. At least one is required. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--columns))
- `data_model_type` (String) Kind of data model, for example PowerBIDataModel or TableauDataModel. Changing it replaces the data model.
- `name` (String) Data model name. Changing it replaces the data model, because the name is part of its fully qualified name.
- `service` (String) Fully qualified name of the dashboard service that owns the data model. Changing it replaces the data model.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Markdown description of the data model.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name shown in the OpenMetadata UI.
- `sql` (String) SQL query that defines the data model.

### Read-Only

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Fully qualified name: <service>.model.<name>.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned UUID.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.

<a id="nestedatt--columns"></a>
### Nested Schema for `columns`

Required:

- `data_type` (String) OpenMetadata column data type, for example VARCHAR, INT or STRUCT.
- `name` (String) Column name.

Optional:

- `data_length` (Number) Maximum length for char, varchar, binary and varbinary columns. OpenMetadata requires it for those types.
- `description` (String) Markdown description of the column.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable column name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID.
terraform import openmetadata_dashboard_data_model.sales 1f6a3a52-8d34-4f4b-9d0f-2f1c1c1c1c1c

# Or import by fully qualified name, which is <service>.model.<data model name>.
terraform import openmetadata_dashboard_data_model.sales warehouse.model.sales_model
```
